Some joints do more for your everyday movement than you may realize, yet they’re often overlooked. Discover which joint plays a key role in mobility, stability, and overall movement—and why keeping it healthy matters.
Brad Heineck, the late Bob Schrupp, and their team created the most famous physical therapy channel, helping millions stay healthy, fit, and pain-free. Bob’s mission lives on through his children and the Bob & Brad team.
